source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Feature Engineering Basics' under topic 6.6 (PDF 84, printed 80).

blocks.text: Feature engineering ka matlab hai data ko behtar seekhne ke qabil banana. Is mein features chunna, badalna aur naye features banana shamil hai. Raw data aksar model ke liye tayyar nahi hota; use cleaning (safai) aur scaling (values ko ek jaise paimane par lana) chahiye hoti hai. Feature engineering model ki performance barhati hai aur aham maloomat ko numayan karti hai. Achhe features behtar andaze dete hain. Is qadam ke liye data ki samajh zaroori hai, aur yeh model ko mazboot banata hai. Misal: marks ke andaze mein parhai ke ghanton ka raw data saaf karna, use scale karna, aur "study hours per day" (rozana parhai ke ghante) jaisa naya feature banana, taake model behtar andaze lagaye.
